source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfântul Ierarh Gheorghe, episcopul Tesalonicului»

attestations.note: His page says in as many words that no synaxarion knows his commemoration — «Pomenirea lui este necunoscută sinaxarelor» — and that he is honoured with the Vatopedi saints on 10 iulie. So the Romanian day is a house commemoration of the Holy Mountain, not an inherited one, and that is what this row records.
